rationale: PINS TWO MISLABELS the lane oracle found, and RECORDS a shared-machinery loss as a checked fact rather than a hole. (1) `overrides` ran BASE -> member, so the edge asserted that the class being overridden is the thing doing the overriding. The direction is not this lane's preference: real-kotlin-analyzer.ts:537 emits `${ownerName}.${s.name}` -> `${parent}.${s.name}`, real-java-analyzer.ts:1866 emits the overriding task's FQN -> the overridden FQN, and script/m60/objc-line-truth.ts:77 says "an override's line is the overriding declaration". Three classes declare `render` so the target alone cannot disambiguate, and the chain GrandChild2 -> Child2 -> Base2 pins that the edge names the IMMEDIATE base's member, not the root's: the metadata carries `overridingMember` and `overriddenMember` qualified because a bare `render` target resolves to four published symbols in this file. (2) `@export` on an S7 class binding pushed the DECLARED class name, so `class_logical <- new_base_class("logical")` produced `exports global -> logical` and no `exports global -> class_logical` -- while the symbol layer, eleven lines above in the same handler, published BOTH names and linked them with an `s7_class_binding` edge, so the graph asserted both that `logical` was not the export and that it was. S7's own roxygen-generated NAMESPACE settles it: `export(class_logical)` at S7/NAMESPACE:66, 25 `export(class_*)` lines, and `export(logical)`/`export(double)`/`export(integer)` appear ZERO times. (3) `` `S7_data<-` `` is a real R name -- R binds it, a package exports it, and roxygen2 quotes it in NAMESPACE exactly because it is not a bare identifier (`export("S7_data<-")` at S7/NAMESPACE:35). The analyzer emits its `contains` and `exports` edges and production `parseFile` deletes both, because src/ast/pool-worker.ts:594 blocks a target leaf matching /[{}`<>\n\r\t]/. That filter is shared machinery and is NOT edited here, so the loss is pinned in `knownProductionLoss`, which asserts the edge is in `analyze()`, is NOT in `parseFile()`, and names the rule. Corpus cost of the same rule, measured over 2,058 files: 299 relationships and 17 symbols deleted, of which `[<-` 19, `[[<-` 16, `$<-` 12, `diag<-` 6, `names<-` 6 -- see validation/m14/fixtures/r/prod-filter-delta.ts.
